bossIntro: Every world boss fight pits the party against one or more of five named bosses. Each one plays completely differently - here's what to watch for.

bosses.name: 🐲 The Dragon
bosses.text: Flies back and forth across the battlefield instead of standing on the ground, breathing fire with every attack it lands - unlike a normal attack, which only hits one hero, this sweeps the whole party at once , so nobody is safe. It also radiates a passive aura for the entire fight that slows everyone's attack speed by 50%. Two looks can show up in a Dragon fight - the classic purple dragon, or the rarer, fully-animated Bahamut - purely cosmetic, same fight either way.

bosses.name: 🐙 Cthulhu
bosses.text: Every 3 seconds, a purple bubble locks onto roughly half the party at random and stacks a debuff that cuts both damage AND healing from anyone it lands on, capped at a brutal 90% reduction - no single hero can carry a Cthulhu fight alone, and hanging back doesn't save you either: sooner or later the bubble finds everyone.

bosses.name: 💀 The Lich
bosses.text: Raises 5 skeletons to fight alongside it every 2 seconds, up to 20 in a single battle. Each one is individually weak - a fraction of the Lich's own health and attack - but they pile up fast if the fight drags on, so speed matters against this one.

bosses.name: 🔥 Fire Demon
bosses.text: No flashy abilities - just relentless heat. Its aura cuts the entire party's healing power by 50% for the whole fight, so healers get a lot less mileage out of every cast.

bosses.name: 🧊 The Gelatinous Cube
bosses.text: Crawls across the field absorbing party members into its body - every 3 seconds it rotates a fresh 10% of whoever's still standing into itself, and while trapped they can't act, though allies can still damage or heal them normally. It also lashes out with a splash attack hitting 5 heroes at once, and every hit it lands stacks a 10% defense shred on that hero (up to 5 stacks, 50% total, each stack lasting 3s) - the longer a fight against the Cube drags on, the softer the party gets.

bosses.name: Multiple bosses at once
bosses.text:
As the world stage climbs, more bosses join the fight at once - it's not a fixed number for a given stage, either: every fight rolls its own boss count with some real variance, trending upward the higher the stage, so two fights at the same stage can genuinely differ in size. It's always a different mix - the game never repeats the last fight's boss back-to-back, and won't repeat a kind WITHIN one fight either, unless there are more boss slots than distinct kinds left to fill them (only relevant at the very highest stages, since there are only five named kinds total).

These five only show up in real world-boss fights. The smaller, more frequent filler encounters between them use weaker, unnamed enemies instead.

classes.name: 🛡️ Warrior
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 16% reduced damage taken - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🪓 Berserker
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 28% increased damage dealt / Skill — Frenzy: killing blows have a chance to grant an immediate extra attack - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🗡️ Rogue
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 7% crit chance - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🥋 Monk
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 13% evasion - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: ⚜️ Paladin
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 55% healing power / 6% intervene - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🏹 Ranger
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 16% splash - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🔮 Mage
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 22% increased crit damage dealt - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 💀 Warlock
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 16% attack speed - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: ✨ Cleric
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): innately hybrid — 50% of every attack converts to healing by default / 55% healing power - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🍃 Druid
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): innately hybrid — 50% of every attack converts to healing by default / 13% evasion - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🩸 Slayer
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 0.11% of damage dealt leeched as life (capped at 20% max hp/sec) / Skill — Flicker Strike: every 5s, dashes to 4 random enemies with +100% splash on each hit - shown at level 1; grows with level.

classes.name: 🔥 Elementalist
classes.rootPassive: Root passive (always active): 16% splash - shown at level 1; grows with level.
